name: Henoch–Schönlein purpura (IgA vasculitis) — skin-limited
advice: Rest with legs raised; spots usually fade in 2–4 weeks. Urine dipstick (blood/protein) and BP weekly for 1 month, then monthly up to 6 months, even if skin clears. Come urgently for severe tummy pain, blood in stool/urine, swelling of face/feet or reduced urine. Tests: CBC, creatinine, urine routine, skin biopsy with DIF (IgA).
